_meta.definition: Rule-15 rulings on the EPS YoY input (Watchlist col 18). value=null means a documented blank; a number means an ex-item YoY % (arithmetic stated in basis) that replaces the yfinance GAAP figure. A ruling applies only while quarter_end matches the name's most recent reported quarter (yfinance mostRecentQuarter); after the next print it is STALE and refresh_objective_inputs.py withholds the cell and re-raises it. Human-written; the script never edits this file.
_meta.refresh_rule: Add/replace an entry in the same session that appends the Rating Audit row (audit_row points at it). Remove nothing: a superseded entry is replaced by the new quarter's ruling.

CIEN.basis: OPERATING, not one-time — ruling CONFIRMS the GAAP figure rather than blanking it. GAAP net income $266.418M vs $50.308M (+429.6%); income from operations alone $301.179M vs $73.535M = +309.6% on revenue +37.0%, so the change is operating-leverage-dominated off a depressed PY base (rule 15: 'a big operational number off a small base stays'). Non-operating delta is recurring, not a gain: interest expense $5.803M vs $22.806M and interest income $22.388M vs $15.090M, both from the completed refinancing and larger cash balance. The only disclosed one-time item is a $7.143M loss on debt extinguishment, which REDUCES the current-period figure — so +429.6% is conservative, not inflated.
CIEN.source: 8-K Item 2.02 Ex-99.1 filed 2026-09-03, Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, quarter ended 2026-08-01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936395/000162828026060245/ex9912026q3earningspressre.htm)
